messages:
sam: CI red on main, failing assume-role step for deploy job. started ~10:10 UTC. ci-bot: job 5421 failed in step `aws-assume`

ci-bot: > Error: InvalidIdentityToken: The web identity token's audience is invalid. expected: sts.amazonaws.com but got: api.github.com

sam: ugh, that looks like OIDC audience mismatch. @chen can you check the IAM trust policy for the role? :eyes:

chen: on it. quick question — did we recently change any of the GH org OIDC settings or add a new audience? iirc we switched a few repos to use `api.github.com` audience last sprint.

avani: i changed the repo workflow a bit yesterday to use `id-token: write` + `audience: api.github.com` for the preview deploys. main still expects sts.amazonaws.com though. could that be it?

marta: if the workflow sets audience explicitly then the token will contain that aud claim. role trust policy only allows sts.amazonaws.com so assume-role-with-web-identity refuses it.

chen: confirm. here's the failing command from the runner logs:
```
COMMAND: aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/redwood-ci-deploy --role-session-name ci --web-identity-token /tmp/oidc_token
ERROR: InvalidIdentityToken: The web identity token's audience is invalid.
```

sam: ok we need a quick unblock. options: revert the workflow audience change, update role trust to accept api.github.com, or create a short-lived PAT in secrets to bypass OIDC. i don't love PAT for security reasons.

avani: i can revert the workflow small change and push a hotfix to the preview workflow in 5m if that unblocks main. which is less blast-y?

chen: safest quick fix is revert on the repo that changed audience to api.github.com. updating IAM requires infra approval and takes longer (we need an IAC PR + reviewer).

marta: agree. revert preview workflow, rerun job, then follow up with infra to add the new audience to the role trust policy in a controlled change. also add a checklist so future workflow edits signal infra.

sam: @avani can you revert & trigger rerun? i'll hold off merging anything else to main. :lock:

avani: done — reverted file, created PR 7893 and pushed a commit to main to pick up old workflow. retriggering CI now.

ci-bot: re-run requested by avani. job 5422 queued.

ci-bot: job 5422 succeeded on assume-role step. deploy continues.

chen: awesome. creating infra ticket to add `api.github.com` to role trust and add a Github Actions change doc. link will be in the ticket.

marta: also adding a small alert to infra dashboard: treat repeated InvalidIdentityToken errors as high priority so we don't get caught again.

sam: thanks all. follow-ups: infra ticket, docs update, add a lint check to detect audience mismatch in workflows. I'll create the lint issue. :white_check_mark:
